units.source_text: 许是名人自愧当时自己没有明察，才特地在这里提及黑121的。

en.t: Perhaps the Master felt ashamed that he had failed to see clearly at the time, and so made a point of mentioning Black 121 here.

units.source_text: 但是，《布局选集》出版时间是告别赛结束一年之后，且是在他去世前半年，

en.t: However, Selected Games in Fuseki was published one year after the farewell match ended, and half a year before his death,

units.source_text: 因此他可能是想起大竹七段下黑121成了话题，才自觉现在必须平心静气地承认这手。

en.t: so he may have recalled that Otake 7-dan's Black 121 had become a topic of discussion, and felt that by then he had to acknowledge the move calmly and fairly.
